title: Mocked-Telegram e2e: loopback Bot API server
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text: Implemented loopback fake Telegram Bot API e2e using real grammY client and real HTTP: paired inbound text becomes a same-session followUp, stranger is ignored, and host-dark deterministic notify sends with zero turns. No new dependencies. Tests: 1 e2e test passed standalone; full suite 21 files / 175 passed (4 todo). pnpm check and pnpm test:coverage green. Files: src/telegram/grammy.ts, tests/e2e/telegram-mock.e2e.test.ts, docs/decisions/0007-telegram-grammy-env.md. Commit 8986a95 pushed to origin/main.
comments.author: agent

description: Loopback mock of the Telegram Bot API (getMe/deleteWebhook/getUpdates/sendMessage) over real HTTP on 127.0.0.1:0, wired via grammY's documented client.apiRoot pattern. Proves the full entry path — webhook socket, queue, pump, escape hatch, grammy client, real HTTP — with zero network beyond loopback and zero new deps (tg-mock/docker rejected per V1 non-goals). Pins ADR-0007 alongside tests/grammy.test.ts.
